title: Incremental import reconciliation for scholarly knowledge bases
items.abstract: We formalize incremental import as a state reconciliation problem and show that fingerprint-based classification prevents silent re-imports in scholarly knowledge bases.

title: Provenance-aware deduplication in systematic literature pipelines
items.abstract: A survey of deduplication strategies that preserve provenance chains when systematic review pipelines merge records from heterogeneous sources.

title: Idempotent upsert semantics for offline corpus snapshots
items.abstract: We define upsert semantics under which re-applying the same offline corpus snapshot leaves the import state byte-identical, and prove a convergence lemma.

title: Incremental ingest harmonisation for scholarly knowledge bases
items.abstract: A record carrying a DOI that already exists in the local state but a contradictory title, to exercise the identity-conflict queue.

title: Provenance-aware deduplication in systematic literature pipelines
items.abstract: A record whose title collides with an imported entry but whose DOI differs, to exercise the second identity-conflict branch.
